items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Elvis Presley came through there and stopped over. ... Yeah, I didn’t like Elvis. No. I says he’s a musician, I’m a musician, I says, his music doesn’t sound as good as mine.

ctx.x: Newfoundland. Ernest Harmon Air Force Base. That’s where all the military planes used to go through — not all of them but a great deal of them — used to go through during the days when they had props, these four-engine jobs. Elvis Presley came through there and stopped over.
